impact: Sentiment gauge for richly valued AI/space megacaps; a broad tech bounce supports GOOGL (SpaceX holder) and growth names but is not a fundamental change.
summary: SpaceX (SPCX) rose roughly 3% to 4.6% premarket Friday to about $131-132, after closing Wednesday up 1.3% at $127.44, as tech rallied and Musk said he will donate another SpaceX share to every American child each year. The stock remains below its $135 IPO price and about 43% below its $225 high.
title: SpaceX up about 3-4.6% premarket, still below $135 IPO price
